menu_note: The shop's current menu and prices are on its own website (athenspizzaonline.com). This concept does not reproduce them: call 802-463-9777 for items and prices.
findings: No menu page on the site; nav is Home, Story, Gallery, Order Online and Apply Now, so the menu is only visible inside the ordering system.
Stale pandemic-era copy ('now open for dining in!'), odd leftover 'from a Dorm' ordering instructions and a capitalized VPN warning dominate the homepage.
A scrolling 'now hiring' banner repeats three times.
No social links on the site.
questions: Are you hiring? We can add an Apply link.
